title.zh: 在马尼拉大都会帕拉尼亚克市将Arcadio Santos博士中学改设为Arcadio Santos博士国立中学并为此提供资金的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Dr. Arcadio Santos High School Into Dr. Arcadio Santos National High School in the City of Paraññaque, Metro Manila and Providing Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Dr. Arcadio Santos High School Into Dr. Arcadio Santos National High School in the City of Paraññaque, Metro Manila and Providing Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Dr. Arcadio Santos thành Trường Trung học Dr. Arcadio Santos Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Dr. Arcadio Santos เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Dr. Arcadio Santos แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sekolah Menengah Dr. Arcadio Santos menjadi Sekolah Menengah Dr. Arcadio Santos Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Dr. Arcadio Santos kepada Sekolah Menengah Dr. Arcadio Santos Kebangsaan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8844_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Dr. Arcadio Santos High School in the City of Parañaque, Metro Manila is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Dr. Arcadio Santos National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
